H700.def: plural of «0699»; Arubboth, a place in Palestine:--Aruboth.

H701.def: patrial from «0694»; an Arbite or native of Arab:--Arbite.

H704.def: the same as «0702»; Arba, one of the Anakim:--Arba.

H707.def: a primitive root; to plait or weave:--weaver(-r).

H708.def: from «0707»; a weaving; a braid; also a shuttle:--beam, weaver's shuttle.

H709.def: from the same as «07263»; stony; Argob, a district of Palestine:--Argob.

H712.et: perhaps from (07264) (in the sense of being suspended)
H712.def: perhaps from «07264» (in the sense of being suspended), a box (as a pannier):--coffer.

H713.def: of foreign origin; purple (the color or the dyed stuff):--purple.

H714.et: from an unused root probably meaning to wander
H714.def: from an unused root probably meaning to wander; fugitive; Ard, the name of two Israelites:--Ard.

H715.def: from the same as «0714»; roaming; Ardon, an Israelite:--Ardon.

H716.def: patronymic from «0714»; an Ardite (collectively) or descendant of Ard:--Ardites.

H717.def: a primitive root; to pluck:--gather, pluck.

H719.def: probably from «07300»; a refuge for the roving; Arvad, an island-city of Palestine:--Arvad.

H720.def: an orthographical variation of «0719»; fugitive; Arod, an Israelite:--Arod.

H721.def: patrial from «0719»; an Arvadite or citizen of Arvad:--Arvadite.

H722.def: patronymic from «0721»; an Arodite or descendant of Arod:--Arodi, Arodites.

H723.def: or rarayah {ar-aw'-yah'}; from 717(in the sense of feeding); a herding-place for an animal:--stall.

H724.et: passive participle of (0748) (in the sense of restoring to soundness)
H724.def: or rarukah {ar-oo-kaw'}; feminine passive participle of 748 (in the sense of restoring to soundness); wholeness (literally or figuratively):--health, made up, perfected.

H725.def: a variation of «07316»; height; Arumah, a place in Palestine:--Arumah.

H726.def: a clerical error for «0130»; an Edomite (as in the margin}:--Syrian.

H727.def: or laron {aw-rone'}; from «0717» (in the sense of gathering); a box:--ark, chest, coffin.

H728.def: or (by transposition) rOwrnah {ore-naw'}; or fArniyah {ar-nee-yaw'}; all by orthographical variation for «0771»; Aravnah (or Arnijah or Ornah), a Jebusite:--Araunah.

H729.def: a primitive root; to be firm; used only in the passive participle as a denominative from «0730»; of cedar:--made of cedar.

H730.def: from «0729»; a cedar tree (from the tenacity of its roots):--cedar (tree).

H732.def: a primitive root; to travel:--go, wayfaring (man).

H733.def: from «0732»; way faring; Arach, the name of three Israelites: Arah.

H734.def: from «0732»; a well-trodden road (literally or figuratively); also a caravan:--manner, path, race, rank, traveller, troop, (by-, high-)way.

H736.def: feminine active participle of «0732»; a caravan:--(travelling) company.

H737.et: passive participle of (0732) (in the sense of appointing)
H737.def: feminine passive participle of «0732» (in the sense of appointing); a ration of food:--allowance, diet, dinner, victuals.

H738.def: or (prolonged) earyeh {ar-yay'}; from «0717» (in the sense of violence); a lion:--(young) lion, + pierce (from the margin).

H739.def: or (arilel {ar-ee-ale'}; from «0738» and «0410»; lion of God; i.e. heroic:--lionlike men.

H740.def: the same as «0739»; Ariel, a symbolical name for Jerusalem, also the name of an Israelite:--Ariel.

H741.et: either by transposition for (0739) or, more probably, an orthographical variation for (02025)
H741.def: either by transposition for «0739» or, more probably, an orthographical variation for «02025»; the altar of the temple:-- altar.

H742.def: of Persian origin; Aridai, a son of Haman:--Aridai.

H743.def: of Persian origin; Aridatha, a son of Haman:--Aridatha.

H745.def: the same as «0738»; lion; Arjeh, an Israelite:--Arieh.

H746.def: of foreign origin; Arjok, the name of two Babylonians:--Arioch.

H747.def: of Persian origin; Arisai, a son of Haman:--Arisai.

H748.def: a primitive root; to be (causative, make) long (literally or figuratively):--defer, draw out, lengthen, (be, become, make, pro-)long, + (out-, over-)live, tarry (long).

H749.et: properly, corresponding to (0748), but used only in the sense of reaching to a given point
H749.def: (Aramaic) properly, corresponding to «0748», but used only in the sense of reaching to a given point; to suit:--be meet.

H751.def: from «0748»; length; Erek, a place in Babylon:--Erech.

H755.et: from an unused root corresponding to (07392) (in the sense of bending the knee)
H755.def: (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to «07392» (in the sense of bending the knee); the knee:--knee.

H756.def: (Aramaic) patrial from «0751»; an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek:--Archevite.

H757.et: patrial from another place (in Palestine) of similar name with (0751)
H757.def: patrial from another place (in Palestine) of similar name with «0751»; an Arkite or native of Erek:--Archi, Archite.

H758.def: from the same as «0759»; the highland; Aram or Syria, and its inhabitants; also the name of the son of Shem, a grandson of Nahor, and of an Israelite:--Aram, Mesopotamia, Syria, Syrians.

H759.et: from an unused root (meaning to be elevated)
H759.def: from an unused root (meaning to be elevated); a citadel (from its height):--castle, palace. Compare «02038».

H760.def: from «0758» and «06678»; Aram of Tsoba (or Coele-Syria):--Aram-zobah.

H761.def: patrial from «0758»; an Aramite or Aramaean:--Syrian, Aramitess.

H762.def: feminine of «0761»; (only adverbial)in Aramean:--in the Syrian language (tongue), in Syriac.

H763.def: from «0758» and the dual of «05104»; Aram of (the) two rivers (Euphrates and Tigris) or Mesopotamia:--Aham-naharaim, Mesopotamia.

H766.et: from the same as (0765) (in the sense of strength)
H766.def: from the same as «0765» (in the sense of strength); the ash tree (from its toughness):--ash.

H767.def: the same as «0766»; Oren, an Israelite:--Oren.

H769.def: or uArnon {ar-nohn'}; from «07442»; a brawling stream; the Arnon, a river east of the Jordan, also its territory:-- Arnon.

H770.def: probably from the same as «0769»; noisy; Arnan, an Israelite:--Arnan.

H771.def: probably from «0766»; strong; Ornan, a Jebusite:--Ornan. See «0728».

H772.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «0776»; the earth; by implication (figuratively) low:--earth, interior.

H774.def: from «07502»; spread out; Arpad, a place in Syria:--Arpad, Arphad.

H775.def: probably of foreign origin; Arpakshad, a son of Noah; also the region settled by him:--Arphaxad.

H776.et: from an unused root probably meaning to be firm
H776.def: from an unused root probably meaning to be firm; the earth (at large, or partitively a land):--X common, country, earth, field, ground, land, × natins, way, + wilderness, world.

H779.def: a primitive root; to execrate:--X bitterly curse.

H780.def: of foreign origin; Ararat (or rather Armenia):--Ararat, Armenia.

H781.def: a primitive root; to engage for matrimony:--betroth, espouse.

H782.et: from (0781) (in the sense of desiring to possess)
H782.def: from «0781» (in the sense of desiring to possess); a longing for:--request.

H783.def: or mArtachshasht {ar-takh- shasht'}; or by permutation gArtachshactu {ar-takh-shast'}; of foreign origin; Artachshasta (or Artaxerxes), a title (rather than name) of several Persian kings:--Artaxerxes.

H784.def: a primitive word; fire (literally or figuratively):-- burning, fiery, fire, flaming, hot.

H786.def: identical (in origin and formation) with «0784»; entity, used only adverbially, there is or are:--are there, none can. Compare «03426».

H787.def: (Aramaic) corresponding (by transposition and abbreviation) to «0803»; a foundation:--foundation.

H788.def: probably from the same as «07640»; flowing; Ashbel, an Israelite:--Ashbel.

H789.def: patronymic from «0788»; an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel:--Ashbelites.

H790.def: probably from the same as «07644»; vigorous; Eshban, an Idumaean:--Eshban.

H792.def: from «0376» and «01168»; man of Baal; Eshbaal (or Ishbosheth), a son of Saul:--Eshbaal.

H793.et: from an unused root meaning to pour
H793.def: from an unused root meaning to pour; an outpouring:--stream.

H795.def: from «07703»; ravager; Ashdod, a place in Palestine:--Ahdod.

H796.def: patrial from «0795»; an Ashdodite (often collectively) or inhabitant of Asdod:--Ashdodites, of Ashdod.

H797.def: feminine of «0796»; (only adverb) in the language of Ashdod:--in the speech of Ashdod.

H798.et: from the plural of (0794) and (06449) with the article interposed
H798.def: from the plural of «0794» and «06449» with the article interposed; ravines of the Pisgah; Ashdoth- Pisgah, a place east of the Jordan:--Ashdoth-pisgah.
